negative_representation.note: PissedConsumer and ConsumerComplaints contain complaints by design (98% Negative). Customers who never complained or never came back leave no trace.

google_play_dominance.note: Pooled percentages mostly describe Google Play app reviews, which are short (median 15 words) and about the app and service in general.

missing_city_and_category.note: Segment comparisons by city and category use a minority of reviews; city is a keyword tag from the review text, not a profile field.

return_evidence.note: Return and Non-Return are predictions from public text, mostly from sentiment. They are not an observed repeat-booking rate; customers who never came back leave no review.

reddit_text.note: Reddit posts are questions and requests more than reviews; no star ratings; permalinks could not be machine-verified; comments are not covered (posts only).

source_coverage.note: Excluded sources could change the balance of themes, in particular Apple App Store reviews.

time_skew.note: Most reviews are recent; older sentiment is under-represented.

method_limitations.coding: Issue, return, alternative and need flags are phrase rules, not a trained classifier; they can miss paraphrases and mis-fire on similar words. Measured precision (6-8 random matches per code): cancelled by the company or professional 88%, professional did not show up 88%, late or delayed 88%, no slots / professional unavailable 100%, prices too high or rising 88%, platform, visit and cancellation fees; policy rigidity 100%, extra charges and parts upselling 100%, support unreachable 75%, refund and payment problems 100%, complaint unresolved, no follow-up 88%, poor or incomplete work 88%, damage or theft 88%, rude conduct, safety, rating pressure 88%, trust, fraud or dishonesty 100%.
method_limitations.sentiment: Sentiment labels come from a lexicon draft plus analyst review of unclear cases (97% agreement on a 150-review check); they are not human-validated.
method_limitations.multi_label_counting: Theme counts overlap by design; do not add them.
method_limitations.small_groups: Only 111 reviews state return behaviour in the first person; household and discovery evidence are only a few dozen reviews. These are too small for statistical claims.
method_limitations.no_llm: These results were not produced by an LLM. An LLM backend (backend/) exists for the upload workflow and later steps.
method_limitations.not_validated: Step 3 (Golden Set, human labelling, accuracy and agreement) has not been run.

interpretation_guidance: Use theme percentages as relative importance within complaints and reviews, not as the share of all Urban Company customers affected.
Treat Return and Non-Return labels as predictions from public text, not as rates; the stated and signalled groups are the stronger evidence.
Prefer equal-weight source comparisons when judging whether a pattern is general or specific to complaint sites.
